svg.text: Pages → Next.js API routes → Prisma → NeonDB Article table, plus presigned uploads → Cloudflare R2

g.text: Next.js API Routes — src/app/api/blogs/* and src/app/api/upload
buildArticleCreateData(data, featuredOrder) / buildArticleUpdateData(data, featuredOrder) — single field-mapping source used by both POST /api/blogs and PUT /api/blogs/[id]
so create/update stay schema-consistent (author, collaborators, itineraryStops, mediaType, videoUrl, comments — all pass-through Json/String fields)
id, slug (@unique), title, excerpt, category, city, categoryIcon, categoryBadgeBg/Text, readingTime
author (Json), collaborators (Json?) ← carries the admin custom-author override payload
date, imageUrl, featured?, featuredOrder? — the ordering fields both /api/blogs routes maintain
likes, views, commentsCount, controversialScore, timesPlanned — real persisted counters (mutated by /metrics)
content? (String? @db.Text), mediaType?, videoUrl? ← stores the R2 publicUrl returned by /api/upload
Client uploads the raw file directly to the presigned uploadUrl
(browser → R2 PUT, bypasses the Next.js server entirely — no
file bytes ever transit through Vercel)
resulting publicUrl is what write/page.tsx then embeds as
imageUrl / videoUrl before POSTing the Article to /api/blogs

svg.text: direct browser PUT with presigned URL (write/page.tsx)

it's purely a client-side UI gate, enforced only at write-time
